race.comment: LEANTOTHEMOON (3) is a former NSW galloper who is rarely far away and sure to be well fancied. Placed 2/3 fresh and comes off a recent trial win. Can run well first try for the new yard. MACHINIST (4)  turned in a bold run first up when he tried to lead throughout but faded and finished fourth, beaten 2.75 lengths at Pakenham Synthetic. Has ability and a bold showing is expected. DIRTY DIANA (6) has been in the market but missed the frame at her last two starts, the latest when sixth over 1200m at Sale. Tricky draw to overcome but can give a sight. WIND DREAMER (10) veteran sprinter who was beaten 2 lengths into third last start over 1000m at Echuca. Include.
